node_definition.done_when: The plan's §8 measure holds as written there, in a new tests/test_agent_readers_use_the_index.py, and its named negative control (the views routed through discover_plans again) is executed and makes both counts exceed zero. A read of a resource the index does not yet cover still answers, by building or reading the index rather than failing, and the answers the views return are unchanged in content for the cases their existing tests cover. The gate is the new test plus tests/test_mcp_views.py, tests/test_mcp_tools.py, tests/test_mcp_roadmap.py, tests/test_read_plan_section_view.py, tests/test_metadata_index_survives_restart.py and tests/test_impl_is_computed.py, run at base and at head. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder; each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. Every pytest process uses a basetemp private to that process. The head arm adds no failure id; any added id means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed paths report no finding the base did not. Scratch goes under /tmp in a directory named for this run and is deleted before status complete. An evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/the-page-paints-from-an-index/agent-readers-use-the-index.html records the change. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
